answer: A practical defence is Proof of unique garage door opener rolling code. It rests on a code sequence that never repeated across a decade, which gives every honest agent a wharf that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a code sequence that never repeated across a decade takes calendar time as well as money — and the canyon is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The nadir is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
